# Pulse Academic
> A free Progressive Web App built by a 3rd grade teacher to help K-12 educators run AI-generated exit tickets, check for understanding, and track formative assessment data — all in under 30 seconds per lesson.

## About
Pulse Academic was created by Gregory Lebed, a 3rd grade teacher with 20+ years of experience, to solve the daily problem of knowing which students actually understood today's lesson. It runs in the browser on any device with no app store download required.

## Core Features
- AI Exit Ticket Generator: upload a lesson plan and get 3 targeted exit ticket questions in seconds
- Formative Assessment Grid: tap each student to mark Got It, Almost, or Needs Help — your whole class on one screen
- Lesson Plan Tracker: upload your week's plans once; each day auto-fills when you open the app
- History and Trends: view results by student or by lesson to see who consistently struggles with which topics
- Week Planning: edit lessons inline, swap days, copy to next day, or skip and push forward
- Any File Format: upload PDF, Word doc, plain text, or paste lesson notes directly

## Audience
K-12 teachers, primarily elementary and middle school educators who want fast, low-friction formative assessment without paper exit tickets or manual sorting.

## Pricing
Completely free. No subscription, no credit card, no app store download required.

Practical teacher-written guides on exit tickets, checking for understanding, formative assessment strategies, and classroom data tools.
